status_definitions.PROVEN: The complete stated requirement is demonstrated at matching scope.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Real implementation or proof exists, but at least one required dimension is unproven.
status_definitions.PENDING: The required implementation or discriminating test has not been completed.
status_definitions.BLOCKED: A concrete, evidenced blocker prevents completion of the requirement.

scope_rules: Offline build, emulation or static evidence never proves hardware runtime.
RAM boot never proves persistent cold boot after flash.
Control-plane readiness never proves client association or traffic.
Bridge Internet does not prove NAT, DNS service or firewall policy.
OEM NOT_APPLICABLE classifications do not silently remove explicit prime-objective requirements.

entries.requirement: Handoff, workspace, blocker and evidence ledger reconstructed
entries.proof_scope: Current state is externally recorded and hash-pinned.

entries.requirement: Every relevant OEM subsystem identified and classified
entries.proof_scope: Thirty OEM capabilities are source-backed; master checklist still contains unclassified or incomplete runtime surfaces.
entries.missing_gate: Close the complete PORTED/REIMPLEMENTED/REPLACED/REMOVED/NOT_APPLICABLE/BLOCKED inventory.

entries.requirement: Stable Linux 5.10 hardware boot
entries.proof_scope: Multiple RAM boots reached Linux 5.10 and userspace.

entries.requirement: UART, Bootbase, TFTP and bootm recovery path demonstrated
entries.proof_scope: Physical cold recovery and exact-image RAM boot are demonstrated.

entries.requirement: Core ARC700 platform execution and interrupt/DMA paths stable
entries.proof_scope: Kernel, IRQ20/28, TQE/FWT/HBM IRQs and DMA-backed traffic crossed hardware gates.

entries.requirement: Real Ethernet traffic remains stable
entries.proof_scope: 600 seconds, 47/47 ping and SSH with strict RX/TX/IRQ progress.

entries.requirement: PCIe host and endpoint enumeration/function
entries.proof_scope: 10ec:818b enumerated with INTx IRQ28 and later sustained radio traffic.

entries.requirement: Native switch datapath and management handoff
entries.proof_scope: TQE/FWT/HBM, dual EMAC VLAN DMA and fresh SSH commit passed on hardware.

entries.requirement: All relevant platform controls and GPIO policy
entries.proof_scope: Stage-0 and WLAN 2.4 LED logic plus button registration are hardware-proven; a separate 5 GHz GPIO1/carrier artifact is reproducible offline but unexecuted.
entries.missing_gate: Hardware-test the postbaseline 5 GHz control artifact, map remaining LEDs and test physical button/reset behavior.

entries.requirement: Repeatable reboot, panic watchdog and autonomous recovery
entries.proof_scope: RAM watchdog and cold recovery are demonstrated; autonomous persistent recovery is not.
entries.missing_gate: Demonstrate panic/hang recovery and repeated autonomous boot on the installed candidate.

entries.requirement: Required SquashFS/JFFS2/MTD storage works safely on hardware
entries.proof_scope: Build/config and fail-closed simulations pass; product storage persistence is not hardware-proven.
entries.missing_gate: Boot the exact SquashFS/storage candidate and validate read-only mtd5/data before transactional writes.

entries.requirement: All relevant EMACs, ports, GPIO/I2C/sensors and platform devices enumerated and tested
entries.proof_scope: Dual switch EMAC and selected controls are proven; complete board inventory is not certified.
entries.missing_gate: Test every physical port and finish GPIO/I2C/sensor/platform-device coverage.

entries.requirement: Switch/bridge and physical client Internet traffic
entries.proof_scope: br0 client association and real Internet Speedtest are recorded.

entries.requirement: WAN and real Movistar ISP configuration operate at final scope
entries.proof_scope: Transparent videobridge uplink provides Internet; a final explicit WAN/ISP profile is not certified. OEM matrix labels routed WAN N/A, but prime objective still names WAN.
entries.missing_gate: Resolve objective scope explicitly and certify the actual Movistar uplink configuration end-to-end.

entries.requirement: DHCP behavior and LAN addressing are reproducible
entries.proof_scope: A physical Wi-Fi client received upstream configuration through the bridge; no final DHCP service/client matrix exists.
entries.missing_gate: Capture lease acquisition, renewal, reconnect and fallback behavior for the final profile.

entries.requirement: DNS query path is directly tested
entries.proof_scope: Internet use is indirect evidence only; no named DNS query test is recorded.
entries.missing_gate: Run and capture client and router DNS queries, failure handling and reconnect.

entries.requirement: Routing and NAT policy are functional where required by the objective
entries.proof_scope: Current Internet proof is transparent L2 without NAT; routed profile is not implemented/certified.
entries.missing_gate: Either certify a routed/NAT profile or formally amend the prime objective using the OEM N/A evidence.

entries.requirement: Firewall policy and management isolation tests pass
entries.proof_scope: No direct firewall policy test is present.
entries.missing_gate: Define and test ingress, management, bridge and failure policies.

entries.requirement: Required IPv4 and IPv6 behavior
entries.proof_scope: IPv4 management and client Internet are proven; IPv6 applicability and traffic are not certified.
entries.missing_gate: Classify IPv6 applicability and run the corresponding address/connectivity tests.

entries.requirement: IGMP, multicast, VLAN and traffic-class behavior match the OEM
entries.proof_scope: IGMP code is built and switch VLAN DMA runs; end-to-end multicast, VLAN policy and DSCP/802.1p are untested.
entries.missing_gate: Run IGMP join/leave, IPTV/multicast, VLAN and QoS parity tests.

entries.requirement: PCI driver, firmware, EEPROM/config and wlan0 interface
entries.proof_scope: Native 5.10 driver probe, firmware, interface and AP initialization are hardware-proven.

entries.requirement: 2.4 GHz AP association and real client traffic
entries.proof_scope: Physical iPhone association, bidirectional traffic and Internet Speedtest passed.

entries.requirement: Secure association, wrong-key rejection, rekey, scan, STA/repeater and reconnect
entries.proof_scope: WPA2 control plane and AP management soak pass; the remaining client/security/mode matrix does not.
entries.missing_gate: Complete secure-client, negative-auth, rekey, scan, STA/repeater and reconnect tests.

entries.requirement: Long-duration 2.4 GHz stability under load
entries.proof_scope: 615.843 seconds is proven, below the mandatory 24-hour F6 soak.
entries.missing_gate: Run at least 24 hours with load, reconnects and error recovery; release target is 72 hours.

entries.requirement: qdrv/wlan and MuC/AuC/DSP platform stack operates
entries.proof_scope: Control, firmware, shared memory, descriptor DMA, IRQ8/9/10 and core start pass; a fatal MuC event still occurs before usable VAP.
entries.missing_gate: Validate the HRFLAGS deferral fix on a cold run without MuC fatal markers.

entries.requirement: Create and retain a healthy wifi0 interface
entries.proof_scope: The current run ends with wifi0 absent after a MuC exception.
entries.missing_gate: Cold-run the pinned HRFLAGS deferral artifact and require vap-pass plus wifi0 DOWN.
entries.blocker: HRFLAGS was sent before the first VAP; MuC faults at uc_hostif_pullioctl+0x98 with EFA 0x3c.

entries.requirement: 5 GHz AP, association, bidirectional traffic and stability
entries.proof_scope: The AP36 bundle and a fail-closed 600-second real-client certificate are offline-ready, but no healthy wifi0 exists and neither has executed on hardware.
entries.missing_gate: Pass wifi0 creation and AP control, then execute the F3 client certificate with association, counters, IRQ bounds and fatal-marker checks.

entries.requirement: ES region, power tables and calibration are preserved and runtime-validated
entries.proof_scope: Regdb, firmware, power-table inputs and production calstate are pinned; RF runtime and EIRP behavior are not validated.
entries.missing_gate: Run ES channel-36 first RF test, verify calibration/power readbacks and then bounded channel coverage.

entries.requirement: Native radar, DFS, CAC and non-occupancy behavior
entries.proof_scope: The fail-closed gate correctly denies DFS; no native Linux 5.10 detector or CAC proof exists.
entries.missing_gate: Implement/port native radar, prove ES/EU regdb, continuous detection, CAC and NOP behavior.
entries.blocker: qdrv_radar_compat returns false/EOPNOTSUPP and the OEM proprietary 2.6 radar binary is not a valid 5.10 backend.

entries.requirement: Explicit secure administrative access
entries.proof_scope: Key-only SSH authentication and live status API are hardware-proven.

entries.requirement: Movistar-compatible management UI runs on the exact current product image
entries.proof_scope: Routes, login, sessions, CSRF, read APIs and volatile staging pass offline and are embedded; the exact CGI image has not booted on hardware.
entries.missing_gate: RAM-boot f8285f5d...e89c and run the live read-only HTTP smoke.

entries.requirement: Required OEM controls are functional, not merely displayed
entries.proof_scope: Ten routes and safe staging exist; password change, applied LAN/radio settings, firmware, reset and full client views remain closed.
entries.missing_gate: Implement transactional handlers and live tests for every required OEM control.

entries.requirement: Relevant OEM services and observable Movistar behavior are ported/replaced/classified
entries.proof_scope: Source-backed role and 30 capabilities are documented; full runtime parity and service disposition are incomplete.
entries.missing_gate: Complete the OEM component disposition matrix and execute each applicable runtime test.

entries.requirement: Power, Ethernet, 2.4, 5, WPS and fault LED behavior matches policy
entries.proof_scope: Stage-0 and 2.4 WLAN LED behavior pass on hardware; the 5 GHz HOSTAP+RUN/carrier GPIO1 artifact passes offline only; remaining front-panel states are absent.
entries.missing_gate: Hardware-validate the postbaseline 5 GHz LED and map/test Ethernet, WPS and fault states.

entries.requirement: Wi-Fi/WPS/reset button behavior is physically verified
entries.proof_scope: GPIO2 input event registration and compiled short/long policy exist; physical press, WPS and reset are unverified.
entries.missing_gate: Perform physical short/long/WPS/reset tests with rollback-safe behavior.

entries.requirement: Configuration backup, restore and reset are transactional and safe
entries.proof_scope: Raw flash backup is certified, but user configuration backup/restore/reset is not implemented or tested.
entries.missing_gate: Implement model/version validation, atomic restore and calibration-preserving factory reset.

entries.requirement: System, ports, radios, clients, bridge, logs and recovery are observable
entries.proof_scope: Status API and logging foundations exist; complete live dual-radio/client/recovery observability is not certified.
entries.missing_gate: Boot the current image and validate every field against proc/sysfs/FDB/runtime truth.

entries.requirement: No management endpoint or diagnostic artifact returns secrets
entries.proof_scope: Current implemented CGI/API surfaces pass secret scans; unfinished endpoints and final release bundle do not yet exist.
entries.missing_gate: Repeat secret scanning over the complete endpoint set, backups and release image.

entries.requirement: Rootfs and firmware-shaped RAM artifact build reproducibly with exact hashes
entries.proof_scope: Rootfs and initramfs/vmlinux/uImage/DTB/webformat are identical across isolated builds; Bootbase/RAS and slot envelope pass.

entries.requirement: The exact current CGI-integrated image passes hardware RAM smoke before flash
entries.proof_scope: Packaging and runner dry-run pass; hardware_ram_boot remains pending in the manifest.
entries.missing_gate: RAM-boot SHA f8285f5d...e89c and run kernel, SSH, Ethernet, radio and UI smoke.

entries.requirement: Immutable regions, calibration and rollback inputs are backed up and verified
entries.proof_scope: Physical flash backup gates are 32/32 PASS and no write occurred.

entries.requirement: Flash target slot and cold-boot autonomously into OpenMitraStar
entries.proof_scope: All current candidates are RAM-only and candidate_eligible=false; the existing persistent slot is known defective.
entries.missing_gate: Earn flash eligibility after full RAM smoke, then write only the selected slot and prove autonomous cold boot.
entries.blocker: No flash-eligible candidate exists; persistent slot can enter EV_TLBProtV and is not a reliable recovery image.

entries.requirement: Configuration survives reboot and controlled power loss
entries.proof_scope: Schema and fail-closed simulations pass; no hardware persistence/power-cut test exists.
entries.missing_gate: Implement atomic persistence and test reboot plus interrupted-write recovery.

entries.requirement: Rollback restores a known-good system after candidate failure
entries.proof_scope: RAM recovery is proven, but rollback after an actual candidate flash is not.
entries.missing_gate: Flash an eligible candidate, induce/observe rollback and verify restored services and immutable regions.

entries.requirement: UART/Bootbase/TFTP recovery remains demonstrated after flash
entries.proof_scope: The pre-flash RAM recovery path is proven only.
entries.missing_gate: Repeat the complete recovery demonstration after persistent installation.

entries.requirement: Minimum 24-hour soak; release target 72 hours under load and reconnects
entries.proof_scope: Current accepted soaks are roughly 10 minutes, far below the release gate.
entries.missing_gate: Complete 24/72-hour dual-radio, multicast, management, reconnect and failure-injection soaks.

entries.requirement: Package is installable, maintainable and releasable without secrets or unredistributable content
entries.proof_scope: A firmware-shaped RAM image and manifests exist; flash eligibility, installer, licensing/SBOM and public blob strategy do not.
entries.missing_gate: Close licensing/SBOM/importer, installer, signature and persistent recovery requirements.

entries.requirement: Every final subsystem has a reproducible status and exact evidence
entries.proof_scope: This matrix and verifier cover the current state, but many rows remain non-PROVEN.
entries.missing_gate: Refresh evidence after each gate and reach zero PARTIAL/PENDING/BLOCKED rows.

entries.requirement: Complete system certification and declaration of 100% migration
entries.proof_scope: Core subsystems are proven, but the final system has not met F3/F4/F5/F6 completion gates.
entries.missing_gate: Close 5 GHz/DFS, network services, complete UI/controls, persistence/flash/rollback and release-soak gates.
